headline: BCPL Railway Infrastructure incorporates real estate subsidiary
hook: New wholly owned real estate subsidiary formed
summary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named AJU Real Estate Private Limited. The certificate of incorporation was issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on September 30, 2026. This corporate restructuring expands the company's business footprint into real estate through a dedicated vehicle. Retail investors can monitor how this subsidiary contributes to the company's asset portfolio and future revenue streams.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings updates reflecting new subsidiary operations
why_it_matters: Subsidiary expansion may diversify revenue sources over time.
